title: Great experience
text:
Very nice atmosphere on board. We had great weather so it was a lovely experience 
The tapas and wine were good and the lady who served us was extremely friendly. There was a mix of people from lots of different countries which made it even better
author: eavan_m

title: Worthwhile
text:
Very lovely boat trip.
Even the torrential rain didn’t “dampen” the trip!
author: 1970doris

title: Amazing river cruise
text: Great experience, relaxing cruise with sangria and some good snacks. Price point good and length was perfect to see the sights ftom boat. Guide was great she waited for me i was a lil late..excellent service!!
author: GrandTour20463893486

title: Great relaxing journey
text: A gentle cruise along the river with friendly staff. One free drink and a plate of Iberian ham and Manchega cheese. We would thoroughly recommend this boat cruise. 1.5 hours long, just enough.
author: fanshabia

title: Seville differently
text: A nice little moment to visit Seville differently, thoughtful and attentive crew
author: patriciabR5874HW

title: Lovely trip on the river in Seville
text: We had a lovely trip on the Guadalquivir River in Seville.  We went on the hours trip with friends.  We were provided with lots of information about the various sites and buildings on the trip.  Weather was glorious.  Would highly recommend.
author: karenoY6662KA

title: Very beautiful cruise on the Guadalquivir
text: Everything was perfect, the snack and the glass of wine, the welcome, the walk, and the explanations in French. I highly recommend this cruise.
author: Stay643270

title: Evening sail down the river
text: Lovely way to spend an evening , lovely sunset . Great way to finish our site seeing day round the sites of Seville
author: Sheena_M

title: Friendly trip
text: Good trip well organised and friendly.
author: JP070766

title: Seville from the river
text: The river cruise was very relaxing and gave different perspective of the city - especially with the guide’s commentary.
author: Jacobus_P
